coverage_gaps: Non-US regulator sources, including EMA and national agency records, are unavailable, limiting cross-jurisdictional comparison of safety actions.
Embase and other subject indexes are unavailable, so PubMed supplies the sole bibliographic retrieval route.
Dedicated citation graphs and DOI metadata services are unavailable, limiting systematic backward and forward citation expansion.
Dedicated retraction databases are unavailable; correction and retraction surveillance relies on PubMed-linked publication metadata.
Preprint servers are unavailable, so recent unreviewed qualifying evidence cannot be searched directly.
Claims, electronic health record, and pharmacovigilance databases are unavailable for direct analysis; only their PubMed-indexed publications can be assessed.
exclusion_criteria: Animal, in vitro, pharmacokinetic-only, or mechanistic studies without decision-relevant clinical safety outcomes.
Studies confined to non-rheumatoid-arthritis indications unless they directly informed an FDA action applicable to marketed tofacitinib or clarify a relevant safety signal.
Efficacy-only reports lacking cardiovascular, malignancy, thrombosis, mortality, regulatory, registry-linkage, or evidence-integrity information.
Narrative commentary, editorials, or news reports that add no independently verifiable primary evidence or correction-status information.
Records dated after 2024-12-31, while retaining later metadata solely when needed to identify a correction or retraction affecting pre-cutoff evidence.
Duplicate manifestations of the same record after PMID, DOI, NCT identifier, FDA document identity, and title-author-year reconciliation; every query-to-record occurrence remains preserved.
Untranslatable records whose population, exposure, comparator, outcome, and timing cannot be assessed reliably.
Safety evidence lacking separable tofacitinib or rheumatoid arthritis results unless it directly supports an applicable FDA class action.
inclusion_criteria: Records concerning marketed tofacitinib exposure in adults with rheumatoid arthritis, including the pivotal postauthorization safety study and direct secondary analyses.
The NCT02092467 registry record, its historical updates through 2024-12-31, posted results, adverse-event data, and publication links.
Primary peer-reviewed comparative evidence reporting cardiovascular, malignancy, thrombosis, or mortality outcomes with extractable population, exposure, comparator, and outcome definitions.
FDA safety communications, reviews, boxed-warning decisions, and prescribing-information changes whose effective date is on or before 2024-12-31.
Observational studies, systematic reviews, meta-analyses, and subgroup analyses that directly qualify, reproduce, or conflict with the pivotal findings.
Corrections, errata, corrigenda, retraction notices, expressions of concern, and linked metadata for any included high-impact record.
Human evidence in any language when sufficient English metadata or translatable content permits reliable screening and extraction.
Online-first publications, issue publications, registry updates, and regulatory actions dated on or before 2024-12-31, with each date type retained separately.

queries.purpose: Recover the pivotal study publication and validate the anchor name, registry identifier, drug aliases, and disease terminology.
queries.query: ((tofacitinib[Title/Abstract] OR Xeljanz[Title/Abstract]) AND ("rheumatoid arthritis"[MeSH Terms] OR "rheumatoid arthritis"[Title/Abstract]) AND (NCT02092467[All Fields] OR "ORAL Surveillance"[Title/Abstract]))

queries.purpose: Recover the pivotal registry record and inspect identifiers, protocol design, outcome definitions, results, adverse-event tables, linked publications, and update history through the cutoff.
Recover FDA communications or labeling that explicitly connect the marketed product to the pivotal safety study.
queries.query: tofacitinib Xeljanz "ORAL Surveillance" NCT02092467 rheumatoid arthritis

queries.purpose: Retrieve broad peer-reviewed safety evidence spanning every decision-relevant outcome without aggressive exclusion clauses.
queries.query: ((tofacitinib[Title/Abstract] OR Xeljanz[Title/Abstract]) AND ("rheumatoid arthritis"[MeSH Terms] OR "rheumatoid arthritis"[Title/Abstract]) AND (safety[Title/Abstract] OR cardiovascular[Title/Abstract] OR malignan*[Title/Abstract] OR cancer[Title/Abstract] OR thrombo*[Title/Abstract] OR mortality[Title/Abstract] OR death[Title/Abstract]))

queries.purpose: Identify registered rheumatoid arthritis studies capable of qualifying the anchor trial and capture alternate study identifiers or linked results.
queries.query: AREA[ConditionSearch]"Rheumatoid Arthritis" AND AREA[InterventionSearch](tofacitinib OR Xeljanz) AND (safety OR cardiovascular OR malignancy OR thrombosis OR mortality)

queries.purpose: Discover FDA safety communications, reviews, labeling revisions, and class-wide actions across the four outcome domains.
queries.query: tofacitinib OR Xeljanz rheumatoid arthritis safety cardiovascular cancer thrombosis death boxed warning

queries.purpose: Confirm the primary publication and all PubMed-indexed records directly carrying the pivotal trial identity.
queries.query: (NCT02092467[All Fields] OR "ORAL Surveillance"[Title/Abstract] OR "Cardiovascular and Cancer Risk with Tofacitinib in Rheumatoid Arthritis"[Title])

queries.purpose: Retrieve endpoint-specific cardiovascular and mortality analyses, including subgroup or risk-factor qualification.
queries.query: ((tofacitinib[Title/Abstract] OR "ORAL Surveillance"[Title/Abstract]) AND ("rheumatoid arthritis"[Title/Abstract] OR NCT02092467[All Fields]) AND ("major adverse cardiovascular event"[Title/Abstract] OR MACE[Title/Abstract] OR myocardial infarction[Title/Abstract] OR stroke[Title/Abstract] OR cardiovascular death[Title/Abstract] OR mortality[Title/Abstract]))

queries.purpose: Retrieve malignancy findings and analyses of cancer type, latency, baseline risk, and comparator effects.
queries.query: ((tofacitinib[Title/Abstract] OR "ORAL Surveillance"[Title/Abstract]) AND ("rheumatoid arthritis"[Title/Abstract] OR NCT02092467[All Fields]) AND (malignan*[Title/Abstract] OR cancer[Title/Abstract] OR lymphoma[Title/Abstract] OR "lung cancer"[Title/Abstract] OR "nonmelanoma skin cancer"[Title/Abstract]))

queries.purpose: Retrieve dose-specific and comparator-specific thrombosis evidence, including fatal thromboembolic events.
queries.query: ((tofacitinib[Title/Abstract] OR "ORAL Surveillance"[Title/Abstract]) AND ("rheumatoid arthritis"[Title/Abstract] OR NCT02092467[All Fields]) AND (thrombo*[Title/Abstract] OR "venous thromboembolism"[Title/Abstract] OR VTE[Title/Abstract] OR "pulmonary embolism"[Title/Abstract] OR "deep vein thrombosis"[Title/Abstract]))

queries.purpose: Confirm the evidentiary basis, chronology, scope, affected formulations or indications, and effective dates of FDA actions.
queries.query: tofacitinib Xeljanz safety trial results increased risk serious heart-related events cancer blood clots death label boxed warning

queries.purpose: Find real-world comparative studies that reproduce, qualify, or conflict with the pivotal trial across baseline-risk strata.
queries.query: ((tofacitinib[Title/Abstract] OR Xeljanz[Title/Abstract]) AND "rheumatoid arthritis"[Title/Abstract] AND (observational[Title/Abstract] OR registry[Title/Abstract] OR claims[Title/Abstract] OR cohort[Title/Abstract] OR "real-world"[Title/Abstract]) AND (cardiovascular[Title/Abstract] OR malignan*[Title/Abstract] OR thrombo*[Title/Abstract] OR mortality[Title/Abstract]))

queries.purpose: Retrieve pooled, systematic, and subgroup analyses while preserving their distinction from direct randomized evidence.
queries.query: ((tofacitinib[Title/Abstract] OR "ORAL Surveillance"[Title/Abstract]) AND "rheumatoid arthritis"[Title/Abstract] AND (meta-analysis[Publication Type] OR systematic review[Title/Abstract] OR pooled[Title/Abstract] OR integrated[Title/Abstract] OR subgroup[Title/Abstract]))

queries.purpose: Detect corrections, errata, retractions, notices, or expressions of concern linked to the anchor study and related high-impact evidence.
queries.query: ((tofacitinib[All Fields] OR "ORAL Surveillance"[All Fields] OR NCT02092467[All Fields]) AND (Correction[Publication Type] OR Retracted Publication[Publication Type] OR Retraction of Publication[Publication Type] OR Published Erratum[Publication Type] OR correction[Title] OR erratum[Title] OR corrigendum[Title] OR retraction[Title] OR "expression of concern"[Title]))

queries.purpose: Actively seek null, conflicting, replication, bias, and limitation evidence that could qualify causal or generalizability claims.
queries.query: ((tofacitinib[Title/Abstract] OR "ORAL Surveillance"[Title/Abstract]) AND "rheumatoid arthritis"[Title/Abstract] AND (conflict*[Title/Abstract] OR contrary[Title/Abstract] OR null[Title/Abstract] OR "no increased risk"[Title/Abstract] OR replication[Title/Abstract] OR bias[Title/Abstract] OR limitation*[Title/Abstract]))

queries.purpose: Capture FDA communications and labeling changes after the primary report through 2024-12-31, preserving each action's effective date.
queries.query: tofacitinib OR Xeljanz rheumatoid arthritis safety communication labeling update cardiovascular malignancy thrombosis mortality 2022 2023 2024

question_frame: Safety/PECO frame: among adults with rheumatoid arthritis receiving marketed tofacitinib, compared with tumor necrosis factor inhibitors or other appropriate rheumatoid arthritis therapies, what do the pivotal postauthorization study, its registry record, primary publication, FDA actions, and qualifying evidence show about major cardiovascular events, malignancy, thrombosis, and all-cause or cardiovascular mortality through 2024-12-31, and do corrections, retractions, expressions of concern, or conflicting analyses alter evidence handling?
stop_rules: Complete all 16 planned query events across every route in source_map and preserve each exact query, execution timestamp, result count, requested cutoff, and provider version when available.
Recover and cross-link the NCT02092467 registry record, the primary ORAL Surveillance publication, and the FDA actions based on the pivotal study; unresolved identity conflicts prevent stopping.

Obtain screenable evidence for cardiovascular events, malignancy, thrombosis, and mortality, plus explicit qualifying or conflicting evidence for each domain or record the domain as an unresolved coverage gap.
Complete correction, erratum, retraction, and expression-of-concern checks for the anchor publication and every included high-impact record.
Apply the 2024-12-31 cutoff after retrieval when indexing syntax is ambiguous and distinguish online-first, issue, registry-update, FDA publication, and FDA effective dates.
Merge records by stable identifiers while retaining all query-to-record links; conflicting duplicate metadata must be escalated and resolved before stopping.
Stop citation-style expansion after two consecutive expansion passes add no new decision-relevant primary record, qualifying analysis, regulatory action, or integrity notice.
Stop when the 16-event query budget is exhausted and report any unrecovered anchor, incomplete outcome domain, unavailable source class, or unresolved conflict as a coverage gap.
Do not stop on result-count stability alone; require completion of source routing, anchor recovery, outcome coverage, integrity checks, and temporal update checks.
